title: Psychology Facts
hook: Kids who waited for a marshmallow. Then what?
facts: In the 1960s, Walter Mischel offered kids *one marshmallow* now, or *two* later.
They had to wait about *15 minutes* alone.
Early studies linked waiting to better later outcomes.
A 2018 replication found the link much *weaker* after accounting for family background.
outro: Waiting was never the whole story.
